title: Headcount sync + interview loop debrief (prep notes)
content:
Meeting: Weekly headcount sync + interview loop debrief (prep)
Owner: Samira Patel (People Ops)
Attendees to nudge: Ethan, Priya, Liam, hiring managers for SWE infra and Serving Runtime
Date: 2026-03-04 (sync with EMs before ops review)

Purpose:
- Quick alignment on active reqs, pipeline health, and blockers for offers this cycle.
- Review outcomes from last week's interview loops, capture debrief action items, and standardize next steps (calibration notes).

Agenda (20-30m):
1) Quick headcount snapshot (2m)
   - Q2 hiring budget: 12 net new engineers (as of last approval)
   - Committed offers this week: 2 (SWE infra x1, Serving Runtime x1)
2) Candidate debrief highlights (10m)
   - SWE Infra loop (Req JIRA-REQ-1248): Candidate A (final)
     - Strengths: system design, latency optimization experience, strong whiteboard
     - Concerns: compensation expectation + relocation timeline (needs 8 weeks)
     - Interviewer consensus: 4/5, recommend proceed to offer pending comp discussion
   - Serving Runtime loop (Req JIRA-REQ-1302): Candidate B (final)
     - Strengths: CUDA/accelerator experience, production inference infra background
     - Concerns: limited distributed systems scale experience (but strong ML infra orientation)
     - Interviewer split: 3x strong yes, 1x hire-with-caution (score avg 4.2)
   - SWE Backend loop (ongoing): two mid-stage candidates need scheduling for comp + system design
3) Calibration points (5m)
   - Scoring variance: note that interviewer X tends to score conservatively (flag for calibration)
   - Use hiring rubric reminder (link in artifacts) when drafting feedback to avoid post-hoc tweaks
4) Offers and compensation (5m)
   - Proposed comp for Candidate A: L4, base 170k-185k, equity band mid; need approval from hiring manager + finance (see PR-87)
   - Candidate B: propose L5 with targeted signing bonus to offset relocation uncertainty
5) Blockers & timeline (3m)
   - Background checks slow for EMEA candidates (Ops ticket filed)
   - Interviewer bandwidth next week limited (on-call + product launch) - escalate to EMs for backup interviewers
6) Action items recap (2m)

Raw notes / open questions: 
- Candidate A: can we accelerate relocation support package? Who in Ops owns relocation policy? Tag: Priya.
- Candidate B: technical due diligence follow-up: request small code sample or design artifact before offer? Hiring manager prefers not to.
- SWE Backend req: need to move to panel by next Wed; who can fill system-design interviewer spot? Ethan to confirm.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Samira: draft offer template for Candidate A with relocation clause (ETA: 2026-03-05) [linked to PR-87]
- Priya: confirm relocation policy and estimated time-to-relocate for EMEA hires (ETA: 2026-03-06)
- Ethan: shortlist backup interviewers for next week (ETA: 2026-03-04 EOD)
- Liam: schedule final panel for SWE Backend (ETA: 2026-03-04)
- Hiring managers (infra + serving runtime): provide final sign-off on comp bands by 2026-03-05
- Samira & Priya: escalate background-check delays with Ops (create ticket if none exists) (ETA: 2026-03-05)

Debrief notes (to capture in candidate files):
- Use standardized feedback template (link in artifacts). For Candidate A, capture specific examples (latency reduction project, perf benchmarks).
- For Candidate B, note the gap on distributed systems and propose 3-month onboarding success metrics (mentor assigned, project goal: KV cache perf story).

Risks / Mitigations:
- Risk: Offer acceptance delayed due to counteroffers. Mitigation: expedite offer + clear timeline, include signing bonus where necessary.
- Risk: Interviewer burnout -> delays to pipeline. Mitigation: create interviewer rotation and reserve 2 panel slots per week.

Notes to self (Samira):
- Prep for exec headcount sync Friday - have summary slide: committed offers, pipeline by stage, top 3 risks + mitigation.
- Pull latest spend against hiring budget from finance (ticket: FIN-HC-2026-02).
- Reminder: update Confluence headcount plan after offers go out (so finance + recruiting dashboards align).

Meeting prep checklist (before sync):
- [ ] Pull current candidate-stage spreadsheet + pivot by team (Samira)
- [ ] Confirm interviewer availability for next two weeks (Ethan)
- [ ] Final comp recommendations ready for hiring managers (Priya)
- [ ] Background-check status for in-flight offers (Priya + Ops)
- [ ] Slide with ask for exec sync (Samira)

Follow-up cadence:
- After sync, send consolidated action-items + owners to hiring managers and people ops (same day).
- Update candidate records with calibration notes within 24 hours.

Quick links: Confluence plan (linked), current candidate tracker (internal spreadsheet link), hiring rubric doc, relocation policy doc.

-- End of prep notes --
